headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.69 (95% CI: 0.38–1.27), indicating no statistically significant association between lutein and bladder cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 71.59%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
